title: Differentiate evaluated jets of a coefficientwise differentiable homogeneous family
statement: Let n∈ℕ, F : ℂ → BinaryForm ℂ n, G : BinaryForm ℂ n, and c,t∈ℂ. Assume that for every exponent vector d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, the function z↦coeff d (F z) has complex derivative c·coeff d G at t. Write D_Y for formal differentiation in variable 1. For every r≤n, the function z↦(D_Y^r(F z))(1,−z) has complex derivative c·(D_Y^r G)(1,−t)−(D_Y^(r+1)(F t))(1,−t) at t.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (F : ℂ → ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n)) (G : ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n)) (c t : ℂ), (∀ d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ, HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => MvPolynomial.coeff d (F z).val) (c * MvPolynomial.coeff d G.val) t) → ∀ r : ℕ, r ≤ n → HasDerivAt (fun z : ℂ => MvPolynomial.eval (fun j : Fin 2 => if j = 0 then 1 else -z) ((fun p : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ => MvPolynomial.pderiv (1 : Fin 2) p)^[r] (F z).val)) (c * MvPolynomial.eval (fun j : Fin 2 => if j = 0 then 1 else -t) ((fun p : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ => MvPolynomial.pderiv (1 : Fin 2) p)^[r] G.val) - MvPolynomial.eval (fun j : Fin 2 => if j = 0 then 1 else -t) ((fun p : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℂ => MvPolynomial.pderiv (1 : Fin 2) p)^[r + 1] (F t).val)) t
